title: Ɔkra a Ɔte Abotare
intro: Wɔ nkɔmhyɛ ho abakɔsɛm mu no, na ɔkra bi wɔ hɔ a wɔakyerɛw ne boasetɔ wɔ wɔn nipasu ntama ankasa mu. Wɔnam nusu ne bere so kuraa anidaso mu denneennen, na wɔbɛyɛɛ ɔsoro nyansa mu ahotoso ho nhwɛso a enni bere mu. So wubetumi ahu ahintasɛm a ɛwɔ saa onipa a onhinhim yi mu?
clues: Wɔwoo me wɔ adiyifoɔ abusua mu, nanso me sɔhwɛ kɛseɛ no nam abofra a medɔ no paa no so.
Minyaa ahoɔyaw ho kɔkɔbɔ fii dae bi a me babarima no soo mu, na na misuro sɛ obenya ahobammɔ.
Awerɛhoɔ nti m’ani danee fitaa, nanso manhwere gyidie wɔ Allah mmɔborɔhunu mu da.
Me ba a wayera no hua fii akyirikyiri duu me nkyɛn, na mihui saa bere no sɛ abɛn sɛ wɔbɛsan ahyiam bio.
M’abusua kotow de anisɔ bere a tete anisoadehu no baa mu, na m’ani san huu ade bio no.
Me ne nea wɔde atade a mogya ayɛ mu ma maa me, na akyiri yi minyaa atade a ɛsaa m’ani so yare.

arabic: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَشْكُوا۟ بَثِّى وَحُزْنِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verse: He said, "I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allāh, and I know from Allāh that which you do not know. (12:86)
